head: 5c943f3060ba2784f8cd69458038ece2deb88a3d
assessment_scope: Complete declared fictional-bank Savia/FLUJO hackathon submission: product/pitch, complete R0–R18 engine, application and generic FLUJO evidence, architecture/development, data pipeline, ML/evaluation, analytics, voice/card and current release qualification. Separate scopes: standalone full generic platform certification, real-bank certification, full 100-agent customer completion and measured ROI.
rubric_note: Independent five-dimension review instrument, not official organizer numeric weights.

dimensions.name: Technical judgment
dimensions.reason: Strong deterministic R0–R18 decisions, owner/session/query/snapshot binding, explicit host consent, missing-risk fail-closed behavior, receipt integrity, terminal uncertainty/replay and durable state. Source and independent fixture checks support a complete fictional workflow. Limited broad end-to-end endurance and crash/cross-process guarantees cap assurance; real-bank certification is outside the assessed scope.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.reason: Integrated bilingual customer UI/voice, grounded selected facts, two actual reviewers and saved follow-up; fleet source independently verifies original native findings/reviews and installation identities. Genuine generic FLUJO source/capacity evidence is included. Live customer samples and suggestion contracts are narrow; larger fleet/human delivery are explicit future acceptance scopes, not reasons to erase implemented success.

dimensions.name: Data engineering
dimensions.reason: Substantial six-table bronze/silver/gold pipeline with lineage, contracts/quarantine, deterministic deduplication, ownership, late arrivals/corrections, exact 5,899,720-row reconciliation, isolated cursors and validated report-before-CURRENT publication. Current fixture checks pass. Static S3 inventory assumptions, lack of power-loss proof and stale-lock operator recovery leave one point of residual assurance.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.reason: Thoughtful rejection of unusable supplied labels; TF-IDF/logistic routing has training-only CV, a frozen independently AI-authored 120-case ES/PT diagnostic, keyword/abstention comparison, uncertainty and error slices. Luna records/audit support 100/100 exact and bounded-safe completions, with a 100/100 deterministic baseline and only ten phrasings. Human adjudication remains pending and eight automated labels are not human truth. Missing local scikit-learn prevents new refitting, while artifact hashes/matrices independently reproduce.

dimensions.name: Data analytics
dimensions.reason: Source findings drive product choices; operating analysis distinguishes safety misses/handoff burden, useful answers/HTTP/persistence, and unrelated latency/capacity workloads. Read-only metadata/HMAC extraction keeps workflow intent separate from verified current host slots and reports malformed/conflicting evidence and cancellation/revocation coverage. Durable usage/cost, exact turn-query-action linkage, and card/lifetime/cohort outcome integration remain material gaps; measured ROI is outside the submission claim.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: Retained owned-transaction explanation, two completed reviewers, helpful acknowledgment and saved context form a working customer journey; 100 team conversations are an explicit architecture target.
first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.discovery: Initial README read before source/receipt verification.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: The complete R0–R18 deterministic motor is the core; the historical 1,725-test/428-subtest source claim is dated and is not a new whole-HEAD pass.
Owned-card protection has explicit consent, durable status and independent receipt readback, and is correctly labeled fictional/demo-ledger behavior.
The data audit exposed cross-owner historical complaint-product links and template-heavy transcripts; owned transactions and independent synthetic routing diagnostics are justified design responses.
FLUJO remains generic; domain work belongs here/Banking MCP or the isolated owner-authorized branch, while source preservation does not imply deployment acceptance.
first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.discovery: Initial repository instructions and boundary read, after README.

Focused current voice suite
pytest_args: result or playback or played or native

prior_attempt.reason: The generic packet deny-all guard blocked required loopback node:http.request/node:net.connect. Corrected with loopback-aware instrumentation; no product failure inferred.

checks.name: Generic FLUJO copied source and dependency-free smoke
checks.limitations: Five retry checks, not a new full upstream suite/build/interoperability or Savia runtime acceptance.

checks.name: Own artifact/pin audit
checks.prior_failure: KeyError for my wrong duplicates_removed key; historical key is duplicate_rows_removed. Fixed in scratch and audit completed.

checks.name: Learned-router refit replay
checks.failure: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named sklearn before fitting. No dependency installed; no fresh learned-output claim.

checks.name: Other reviewer setup failures
observations: Initial package metadata list aborted on absent scikit-learn; safe per-package inventory records missing dependency.
First PowerShell-quoted voice preparation had parser error before execution; literal here-string preparation then ran and all selected voice checks passed.
Initial inventory included a nonexistent docs/submission/flujo-source path; correct packet path docs/submission/measurements/flujo-platform was followed.

defects_and_gaps.finding: No reproduced ownership, consent, idempotency, receipt-integrity or snapshot-publication defect in the selected current checks.
defects_and_gaps.scope: Declared fictional-bank hackathon prototype, not universal or real-bank certification.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Synthetic AI-authored ground truth and narrow semantic diversity; eight labels reviewed by AI are 8/120 agreement, not independent human truth. Raw/abstaining router human misses remain 3/30 and 1/30, with 52 unnecessary human routes under abstention.
defects_and_gaps.action: Version untouched human-adjudicated ES/PT cases, including negation/security/vulnerability/regional and open-ended selected-fact cases; preserve the frozen holdout and report escalation burden alongside safety.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Exact registered captions and PCM playback ACKs do not establish waveform-script alignment, full caveat comprehension, physical microphone/AEC or complete speech after a clean premature PCM EOF.
defects_and_gaps.action: Independent full WAV listening/transcription and actual-device microphone/interruption qualification.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Model usage/cost is not durably persisted; exact workflow turn/query-to-host-action attribution is unknown; current-slot analytics does not join card/lifetime/cohort outcomes.
defects_and_gaps.action: Persist supplied usage and explicit operation/query linkage; build bounded card/lifetime/cohort projections before pilot cost/resolution/repeat-contact claims.

defects_and_gaps.finding: October 5 integrated ten-by-ten customer attempt failed on disabled provider workspace before accepted fleet result. Recorded two-reviewer customer success, generic capacity and real sandbox collaboration remain valid separate workloads. Real ticket pickup/push/email/multi-day reliability are unqualified.
defects_and_gaps.action: Qualify original run bindings, headcounts, collaboration and accepted customer findings, then real ticket/delivery adapters; do not require these future scopes to relabel the current recorded prototype.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Original customer comparison n=3 has useful answers 2/3, including a Portuguese selected-fact failure. Separate n=1 retry displays useful facts through trusted fallback rather than accepted free-form model generation.
defects_and_gaps.action: Preserve denominators and test fresh diverse selected-fact cases rather than pooling the retry into the original result.

defects_and_gaps.finding: S3 ingestion assumes stable inventory rather than VersionId pins; pointer replacement does not prove power-loss durability or a transaction across filesystems; generic packet is a partial source subset with dependency-cache differences and mocks.
defects_and_gaps.action: Clean locked builds, interoperability, crash and endurance acceptance would strengthen future deployment assurance.

defects_and_gaps.finding: ElevenLabs comparison says built with two people while the README/development story credit three contributors; competitive claims are positioning/vendor reported, not a matched experiment.
defects_and_gaps.action: Align contributor phrasing and keep vendor metrics separate from measured Savia workload claims.

limitations: Repository-only review; no external availability, providers, deployment, neighboring repositories, private source data or remote film playback.
The historical full supplied-data counts were reconciled as published aggregates and mechanisms were exercised with synthetic fixtures; private organizer rows were not reread.
Selected existing checks plus artifact/source congruence, not a full unchanged suite replay or complete Windows/Linux/native/compiler certification.
External connection guards are instrumentation, not an operating-system sandbox; provider/MCP doubles and loopback plumbing are part of the offline test scope.
scikit-learn absent; NumPy 2.2.5 and SciPy 1.18.0 differ from historical ML replay. No learned refit or dependency installation.
Frontend node_modules absent; no new React production build/UI suite. Generic FLUJO full upstream tests require a full pinned checkout/dependency cache outside this permitted repo-only review.

Core historical 1,078 results do not transfer to entire current HEAD: current repository.py includes the separately qualified readiness/legacy manifest change. Final runtime manifest matches all current 183 Git blobs.
Model catalog and recorded request model are not independent server-side identity attestation; overlap is not GPU concurrency; exact fixture correctness is not general real-customer quality.
Real-bank certification, live money/refund, human pickup, full 100-agent customer completion and measured ROI are separate scopes and were not required for this fictional-bank submission score.
